# Vox Collage — Dark Society Edition (Google Antigravity)

> An open-source Google Antigravity Agent Skill that turns a topic — or a ready script + voiceover — into a finished Vox-style paper-collage documentary: script, collage keyframes via Antigravity's built-in Nano Banana, local OpenCV object-level animation (`vox_animator.py`), DarkPlanner or Google Gemini TTS narration (`audio.py`), and paper-cutout captions (`assemble.py`).

## Core Workflow
1. **Voice & Beat Map (`beats.json`):** The agent asks which voice provider (`DarkPlanner` or `Google TTS`) and voice to use (or accepts a pre-recorded `.mp3` via `--from-audio`), then drafts a fast-paced beat map (3.5s–5s per shot).
2. **Audio & Word SRT (`scripts/audio.py`):** Generates or slices the voiceover, applies broadcast dynamic leveling via FFmpeg, and creates word-level `_palavra.srt` files.
3. **Collage Keyframes (`scripts/keyframes.py` + Antigravity Nano Banana):** Composes 5-layer editorial paper-collage prompts and generates posters directly inside Google Antigravity (`image-generator`).
4. **Object-Level Animation (`scripts/vox_animator.py`):** Extracts objects from inside the collage posters, reconstructs the background via OpenCV `cv2.inpaint`, and animates cutouts in 10fps stop-motion + procedural 2D VFX.
5. **Assembly (`scripts/assemble.py`):** Concatenates all animated shots, burns SRT-synced paper-cutout captions (`scripts/text_overlay.py`), and outputs `out/<project>/final.mp4`.
